messages:
Mira (Docs): Quick catch: migrating customers from v1->v2 reported index breakage when an embed alias swap changed vector dims. We need a short deprecation note + migration playbook.
Sam (SDK): Can you paste the minimal repro (truncated)? We'll add a detection snippet.
Mira (Docs): Truncated repro:
```
POST /v2/embeddings
body: {"model": "alias:embed-main", "input": "hello"}
response: {"data": [{"embedding": [ ...1536 floats... ]}]}
```
Ben (Eng): That's expected if alias points to a different family. Infra should expose `vector_dim` in the model catalog so docs/SDK can show it.
Ria (Product): Product asks for: 1) migration banner, 2) 4-step checklist (sample test, compare dims, reindex or pin, ramp), 3) FAQ bullet.
Sam (SDK): Snippet to include:
```
resp = client.embeddings.create(...)
dim = len(resp.data[0].embedding)
if dim != expected_dim:
    raise RuntimeError("embedding size mismatch: pin model version or reindex")
```
Mira (Docs): I'll draft PR with banner, migration subsection "Embedding dimensionality changes", and FAQ. Will avoid full vectors. PR will include JS/Python/Go snippets.
docs-bot: created task DOCS-1510 assigned to @Mira, @Sam, @Ben, @Ria due in 7 days.
Sam (SDK): I'll open SDK PR with tests and reference the docs PR.
Ben (Eng): I'll file INF-912 to add `vector_dim` to /models and run a quick telemetry job to assess impact.
Mira (Docs): Thanks—pushing draft now and will tag reviewers. :white_check_mark:
